svg.text: Extraction is table stakes. Validation is the moat.
A tool that extracts fluently and validates weakly is the "looks finished, might be
wrong" trap — applied to a number where wrong is a loss.
· identify every covenant — financial, negative, affirmative, reporting
· capture each defined term and its dependencies
· record thresholds, baskets, add-backs, step-downs, amendments
hard — and where most tools concentrate (the demoable 80%)
· extracted structure matches the agreement, clause for clause
· computed ratios footed & reconciled to the borrower's reporting
· add-backs applied within their caps and lookbacks · clause-level citation + confidence
· abstain → human review when a definition is ambiguous or an input is missing
